name: Chaos Central
desc:
add to the chaos... survive the chaos... die the chaos... :(

an increasingly chaotic bullet-hell type game where you survive levels of attacks, choosing new hazards to add to the mix as you go, until you simply cannot go any further.
manage points to afford upgrades efficiently and to better prepare yourself for what's to come...

⚠️chaos central is HARD and the difficulty curve is steep for new players, but the more you try, the more you can familiarize yourself with each individual hazard, making it smoother to play. don’t give up!!
⚠️this game has a lot of flashing lights and intense visuals!!

chaos central is actively under development and some bugfixes/changes may be getting tested in public servers. if something's off or shouldn't be there, that's probably why!

inspired by every (minigames) end and nullscape, among other things.

scripts.title: God Mode / immortality / Hazard Remover
scripts.script:
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")

local platform = workspace:FindFirstChild("SafetyPlatform")

if platform and platform:IsA("BasePart") then
    local base = Instance.new("Part")
    base.Size = platform.Size
    base.CFrame = platform.CFrame
    base.Anchored = true
    base.CanCollide = true
    base.Transparency = 1
    base.Parent = workspace
end

for _, name in ipairs({"Script", "SafetyPlatform", "SafetyNet"}) do
    local object = workspace:FindFirstChild(name)

    if object then
        object:Destroy()
    end
end

pcall(function()
    StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
        Title = "Some Lasers and Void ARE GONE",
        Text = "made by gpjc.",
        Duration = 2
    })
end)
